name: Rubeosaurus
sum: Rubeosaurus is a centrosaurine from the Two Medicine Formation of Montana, erected for a species first placed in Styracosaurus.
wsnote: No size given in the sources used.
holotype: Specimen described by Gilmore in 1930 as Styracosaurus ovatus (catalogue number not given in the sources used) — Two Medicine Formation, Montana.
material: A subadult specimen described by McDonald in 2011.
biology: Known from skulls; no behavioural data.
author: McDonald and Horner 2010

sources.text: A. T. McDonald and J. R. Horner. 2010. New material of "Styracosaurus" ovatus from the Two Medicine Formation of Montana. New Perspectives on Horned Dinosaurs: The Royal Tyrrell Museum Ceratopsian Symposium. Indiana University Press, Bloomington
